name: Harriet the Spy
description: Outspoken and perpetually curious. That's 11-year-old Harriet in a nutshell. But if she’s going to be Harriet M. Welsch, future writer, she'll need to know everything. And to know everything means she'll need to spy...on everyone.

videos.title: I Am a Terrible Spy
videos.overview: Harriet's ambition to know and see everything may change reclusive Agatha K. Plumber's life for the better.

videos.title: Coat Vote
videos.overview: Harriet's new coat is perfect for her—and Marion Hawthorne, apparently. But who will win the school's vote?

videos.title: Cross My Heart and Hope Not to Dance
videos.overview: Janie and Harriet vow never to go to dancing school, but Harriet doesn't know that Janie actually likes dancing.

videos.title: Hermit the Spy
videos.overview: After an awful day, Harriet wants some alone time. Watching Mr. Withers' 26 cats is just what she needs...or is it?

videos.title: The Origin of M
videos.overview: Harriet learns about her middle initial and questions who she is. Her nanny, Ole Golly, teaches Harriet a valuable lesson about identity.

videos.title: Face the Music
videos.overview: Janie and Harriet get to meet their favorite singer, only to discover a shocking truth about his music.

videos.title: The Rarest Bird
videos.overview: Harriet really wants to win a photo competition, but it means teaming up with someone she doesn't see eye to eye with: her mom.

videos.title: The Stuffy Lovers
videos.overview: Sport and Harriet think it's time to get rid of their beloved stuffies, but change their minds—and the narrative—thanks to Marion's sneaky reporting.

videos.title: Spy V. Spy
videos.overview: Harriet adds the Garcia family to her spy route...and discovers that someone is spying on her.

videos.title: To My Future Self
videos.overview: On her birthday, Ole Golly revisits a list of everything she wanted to do by the age of 35—and Harriet is determined to help her complete it.

videos.title: General Mouthwashington
videos.overview: When Harriet loses her last—and favorite—baby tooth, she struggles with saying goodbye to her babyhood.

videos.title: It's My Party and I'll Spy If I Want To
videos.overview: The Welsch family attends a neighborhood party where Harriet is determined to find out why the Robinsons are so boring.

videos.title: World of Tomorrow
videos.overview: At the world's fair, Harriet meets a 14-year-old photographer who's unsure of his future—but shows Harriet how to cherish today.

videos.title: Lucky Penny
videos.overview: Sport joins Harriet for a local scavenger hunt. But when he brings his good-luck charm to improve their chances, Harriet is skeptical.

videos.title: Ole Golly in Love
videos.overview: While Harriet's parents are out, she and Ole Golly join Mr. Waldenstein for a movie date. But can they get home before Harriet's parents do?

videos.title: The Walrus and the Carpenter
videos.overview: When Ole Golly announces she and Mr. Waldenstein are getting married and moving to Montreal, Harriet tries to change her mind.

videos.title: The Age of Harriet
videos.overview: Harriet's dream of creating a post–Ole Golly life is shattered when her notebook falls into the hands of her nemesis: Marion.

videos.title: Everyone Hates Me
videos.overview: The fallout from her private thoughts becoming public leaves Harriet fighting to repair her friendships—and for the return of her notebook.

videos.title: I Am the Onion
videos.overview: With the notebook causing quite a stir, Harriet hopes a backyard trial of her peers will prove her innocence.

videos.title: Harriet the Writer
videos.overview: After Harriet makes an unexpected discovery, she comes up with a plan to right her wrongs.
